case.request: Employee changes the bank account the salary is paid into

steps.name: Receive the request
steps.description: The employee's request for a new salary bank account reaches the payroll consultant through the agreed channel.

steps.name: Check the IBAN
steps.description: Check that the IBAN is valid and that the account holder is the employee.

steps.name: Verify the employee's identity
steps.description: Make sure the request really comes from the employee (fraud control: payroll diversion).

steps.name: Enter and release the change in SAP
steps.description: Enter the new IBAN in SAP and release it for payroll.

steps.name: Apply the payroll cut-off
steps.description: Decide from which monthly payroll run the new IBAN applies.

steps.name: Confirm to the employee
steps.description: Tell the employee the change is done and from when it applies.

steps.name: File the request
steps.description: Keep the request and the checks as evidence.
